'''George R. Newkome''' is an [[Americans|American]] [[scientist]] and [[chemist]], currently the Professor of [[Polymer science|Polymer Science]] and Chemistry and James and Vanita Oelschlager Professor of Science and [[Technology]] at [[University of Akron]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.uakron.edu/dps/faculty/profile.dot?id=865ff8f4-b6fe-4244-a9ff-2cfaa245c769 |title=George R. Newkome |publisher=uakron.edu |accessdate=November 8, 2016}}</ref> and has also published both science papers and [[Science book|books]], being largely cited and collected in both capacities.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n82035623/ |title=Newkome, George R. |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=November 8, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=-jxy3P0AAAAJ&hl=en |title=George R. Newkome |accessdate=November 8, 2016}}</ref>
